scripts.build: npm run build -w @spectwin/engine && npm run build -w @spectwin/api && npm run build -w @spectwin/web
scripts.test:unit:coverage: c8 --all --src packages/engine/src --reports-dir reports/unit-coverage --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --lines=90 --statements=90 --functions=100 --branches=70 node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/unit-junit.xml tests/engine.test.ts tests/scenario.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:coverage: c8 --all --src apps/api/src --src packages/engine/src --reports-dir reports/integration-coverage --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --lines=85 --statements=85 --functions=90 --branches=65 node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/integration-junit.xml tests/api.test.ts
